Its renderTile method handles the logic for drawing each tile and managing their positions, which is critical for handling edge cases near the antimeridian. The getData method is also involved in mapping screen pixels to tile coordinates, which could be sensitive to reprojection bugs.

- src/ol/reproj/Tile.js//ReprojTile: This class represents a single reprojected tile. Its constructor performs the calculation of source and target extents, resolution, and triangulation, all of which are crucial for correct reprojection near the antimeridian. The reproject_ method does the actual reprojection, and load manages the asynchronous loading of tile data. Bugs in extent handling or triangulation here can directly cause missing or incorrect tiles at projection discontinuities.

The configure_ method sets up the tile grid and related parameters based on the GeoTIFF images, and determineProjection establishes the projection context. Errors here could result in misaligned grids or sources, especially when non-default projections or custom extents are used.

- src/ol/tilegrid/TileGrid.js//TileGrid: This class defines the structure of the tile grid, including calculation of tile extents and coordinates. Errors in tile calculation, especially across the antimeridian, can cause tiles to be omitted or incorrectly placed.

The functions identified are those that are most likely to contain logic related to tile extent calculations, reprojection, grid setup, and rendering, all of which are directly implicated by the symptom of missing tiles near the antimeridian when using a custom stereographic projection and GeoTIFF source.
